description: This file defines a PHP trait named UserAgentTrait within the Aws\S3\Crypto namespace. It contains a method to append a user agent string to HTTP requests handled by the AWS SDK, modifying request headers to include custom user agent information for client identification.

methods.name: appendUserAgent
methods.description: Appends a custom user agent string to the headers of an AWS client request by modifying the 'User-Agent' header. It checks if the header exists, appends the string if missing, or sets it if not present.
